turn.user_message: What changes on the ward, step by step?
turn.context: Playbook §4, process changes: function by function, today and with the changes. The biggest leak flagged.

text: Seven changes, one for each step of the day. The work itself stays the same. Only its timing moves.
The biggest hold-up is the summary. Moving it to the evening round frees most of the morning.
chat.pointer: Move one magnet at a time, or switch the whole board to the new way.
chat.invite: Next, we can size the team that keeps this running.
chat.note: Same work. Earlier in the day.
prompts: Do we need to hire anyone?
Who at the bed desk would see this?

blocks.title: Same work, earlier in the day
blocks.deck: Each step of a discharge, today and with the changes. Your Head of Operations approves the new order.

rows.name: Evening round
rows.with: Likely discharges marked with one tap

rows.name: Discharge summary
rows.today: Typed next morning, waits for a signature
rows.with: Drafted overnight, signed on the morning round

rows.name: Supplies and bill
rows.today: Counted and drawn up after signing
rows.with: Kept up to date all through the stay

rows.name: Bill sign-off
rows.today: Built from the start at the end

rows.name: Insurance
rows.today: Asked once the bill is final
rows.with: Early request sent the evening before

rows.name: Family and transport
rows.today: Called at the end of the day
rows.with: Told the leaving time the night before

rows.name: The bed
rows.today: Hears late, so cleaning starts late
rows.with: Told the moment the patient leaves

blocks.keeps: The flow of work stays the same. The new timing sits on top of it, and costs nothing but order.
